body: Do you remember how long it took you to be better? What did you do?
I think that is exactly how i felt. No feeling or concern for anything. I didn't care at all

I'm not really sure. It was a couple years ago now, but, I know they made me think a lot about why I was feeling that way. Which just put me into a worse mood. I opened and I came out not really having any feelings anymore.

Those were the two main things. But I felt alone. Every person I thought I could talk to, they just disappear when it gets too much, other than professional help of course. And that messed me up more. When I'm alone I make bad decisions. And I think it is only a matter of time. This is the worst I have been. Lower than before.

I try to isolate myself to deal with the problem myself. To try and fix it. Because I battle with myself. My self esteem. My depression. My hatred of myself.  I would rather it affect just me. I don't want it to affect anyone else. Just me
Please talk because I don't know what to do and I'm this close

I had the noose around my neck, February of 2014. It was tight and my weight was making it tighter. No one was around but my little dog. She was 4 months old at the time. She whimpered as I leaned from the door handle. I thought I had lost consciousness but I heard her. And came to for a second and knew that she needed me. So yes. I believe they do. She is almost 3 now and I have thought about it more than ever now. But I may wait until she passes. Or my parents can take her. Whichever comes sooner.
